laws.name: PASSIVE_INGREDIENT
laws.scope: mutation selection; any ingredient (knob, permutation, allocation trick) activated in a flywheel round
laws.statement: An ingredient activated in 3 flywheel trials with no estimator change beyond shot noise is dead: the mechanism class is killed and its fixtures become repeat-forbidden.
laws.evidence: Port of the ARC-AGI-3 passive-information law (measured payoff: 25-35 GPU-h of repeat burns prevented after codification).
laws.reopening_falsifier: A structurally new activation of the same ingredient (different mechanism path, not a parameter rescale) produces a paired CI-excluding-zero improvement on val.

laws.name: NO_ORACLE
laws.statement: No candidate is accepted without a frozen-basis incumbent: comparisons are always against the current ledgered incumbent under the frozen suite manifest, never against a re-tuned reference.
laws.predicate_description: promotion requires incumbent_spec_sha256 present and equal to the frozen manifest basis
laws.evidence: JS-ASIC ledger lineage: every PROMOTE names its parent experiment.

laws.name: HOLDOUT-PROTECTED
laws.statement: The 12 LOCKED holdout circuits are evaluated exactly once, at campaign close, by a dedicated evaluator that first checks campaign completion in the ledger. Any interim touch voids the campaign.
laws.predicate_description: holdout_eval runs only if ledger shows EXP-005 terminal AND holdout_eval.json absent
laws.evidence: Adjudicated design (RSI-SYSTEM-DESIGN.md S5 divergences: terminal-only holdout + val canary).

laws.name: NO-HEALTHY-RERUN
laws.statement: A completed, valid run is never re-executed. Re-execution is allowed only for INFRA-class failures (network, queue timeout, sandbox) with a cause class recorded in the ledger.
laws.predicate_description: re-dispatch allowed only if previous attempt has cause_class in {INFRA_FAILURE, AMBIGUOUS_ACK}
laws.evidence: JS-ASIC 3-attempt cap + ARC immutable sha-verified harvest.

laws.name: COST-INCLUDES-QUEUE-MINUTES
laws.statement: The cost axis of every Pareto comparison is total wall minutes = queue + run time summed over the round's jobs, not run time alone.
laws.predicate_description: score (cost) metric = sum(queue_time_ms + run_time_ms)/60000 over round jobs
laws.evidence: Adjudicated design: queue minutes are real spend on a metered platform.
